text: I'm going to say the part that women don't want to tell men. Men are fucking pests. There is no amount of niceness, there is no amount of being cordial, there is no amount of kindness that a man can present to a woman that would overshadow the fact that men are pests. They are pests. They were literally designed to be pests. In just about every species of animals, the females have to literally play dead. So apparently the new trend is calling men pests. Amazing. This is the level of wisdom we're getting online now. Let's be honest, this isn't empowerment, it is simply quite an open hate on men. And somehow it gets applause. Men are pests designed to be pests. Really? Designed by who exactly? The universe? Biology? God? Disney? Because last time I checked, men build the world you live in, protect the society you walk through, and keep the infrastructure running. But sure, let's call them pests. And the comparison to animals? Just about every female species has to play dead to avoid males. Which species exactly? Dogs? Cats? Eagles? Sharks? Cows? Horses? Someone has got to watch more National Geographic before comparing humans to animals. Guys, you should understand, women who genuinely hate men never end up with good men. Why? Because good men don't choose women who openly hate them. They pick women who appreciate them, respect them, and actually understand how relationships work. So don't let clips like this get into your head. If a woman calls men pests, she's telling you everything you need to know. She's not someone to argue with, fix, or educate. She's someone to avoid. Focus on the women who treat men like human beings, not insects.
